name: vwap_mean_reversion_v18
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, sharp intraday selloffs push the index 40-80 spot points below session VWAP. At this deviation level, every VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithm is sitting on large positive tracking error and begins aggressively accumulating — they are getting fills significantly better than their benchmark and are structurally compelled to buy. The accumulation shows up as a slowing in the rate of deviation change (dev_momentum turning positive) before price visibly recovers. We enter at the first bar where the z-score is still extreme (below -1.7 sigma of the session's deviation distribution) but momentum is already turning, capturing the onset of institutional re-entry rather than chasing after it.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset each session day
indicators.purpose: Cumulative VWAP from session open — no scaling needed. VWAP is a session-anchored benchmark used by institutional algos; it accumulates from the open regardless of bar size.

indicators.name: vwap_stddev_360
indicators.purpose: Rolling 30-minute (360 bars × 5s) standard deviation of (close - VWAP) used to normalize the deviation into a z-score. 30 minutes captures the current intraday volatility regime rather than the original's full-day window — we want the z-score calibrated to today's session amplitude, not yesterday's. Minimum floor of 0.5 pts to avoid division noise in low-vol periods.

indicators.name: vwap_zscore
indicators.purpose: Session-normalized deviation from VWAP. Replaces the original's STDDEV(close, 21) normalization — we normalize against the distribution of deviations from VWAP, not raw price, which makes the threshold scale-invariant across different NIFTY levels.

indicators.name: dev_momentum_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute (24 bars × 5s) change in VWAP z-score. Positive for a buy_ce signal means the negative zscore is shrinking — selling pressure is abating. This replaces the original's rel_volume > 1.6 filter because NIFTY index volume is noisy (basket rebalances, roll-overs inflate volume without signalling panic). The rate of deviation change is a cleaner proxy for when institutional accumulation has begun.

conditions: close < vwap (index trading below fair value)
vwap_zscore < -1.7 (extreme negative deviation: ~40-70 NIFTY pts below VWAP in typical session)
dev_momentum_24 > 0 (z-score turning less negative — selling pressure abating, institutional buying starting)
buy_ce.confirmation: dev_momentum turning positive while zscore still extreme

conditions: close > vwap (index trading above fair value)
dev_momentum_24 < 0 (z-score turning less positive — buying pressure abating)
buy_pe.confirmation: dev_momentum turning negative while zscore still extreme

exit.stop_rationale: 6 option points because deep VWAP deviations often see a final flush of 10-15 spot points before reversing — a 3-4 option point stop would be triggered by this flush. At delta 0.5, 6 option pts = 12 spot pts, giving the trade room for the typical final flush while still protecting against the rare trending continuation that never reverts.
exit.target_rationale: 10 option points = ~20 spot points at delta 0.5. Deep VWAP deviations on NIFTY (>40 pts) historically mean-revert 50-70% of the overshoot within 2 minutes. Capturing 10 option pts captures roughly the lower end of this range (1:1.67 R:R), biased conservatively since we are exiting well before full VWAP touch.

filters.vix_filter: none — VIX high days are exactly when VWAP deviations are largest and reversions fastest
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:20 IST; skip first 15 minutes to let VWAP establish a meaningful baseline
filters.volume_filter: none — index volume is noisy; using dev_momentum as cleaner signal
filters.trend_filter: none — VWAP z-score is already session-normalized, handles trending days via zscore threshold
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — VWAP reversion is structural (institutional mandate) but threshold sensitivity means strong trending days can produce multiple false signals before regime is evident

adaptation_notes: The original trades nifty200 stocks on 15-min bars using raw price z-score (STDDEV of close, 21 bars) and relative volume surge (> 1.6x) as a panic detector. Three key changes: (1) Universe → single index: the NIFTY index is smoother, more liquid, and directly driven by institutional VWAP algo flow rather than retail panic, so the reversion mechanism is actually stronger. (2) Relative volume dropped → dev_momentum_24 added: NIFTY volume includes basket rebalances and derivatives roll that create false volume spikes; deviation momentum is cleaner. (3) Normalization → z-score of deviations not raw price: (close - VWAP) / STDDEV(close-VWAP, 360) makes the threshold scale-invariant. Lookback for stddev is 30 min (360 bars) capturing current session regime; VWAP itself needs no scaling as it is cumulative. The hold time compression from 30-60 15-min bars (~10-15 hours equivalent, clearly a metadata error in original) to 120 seconds is the most dramatic change — at 5s resolution, the first 60-120 seconds of institutional re-entry is the high-edge window.
weaknesses: Strong trending days (e.g., big macro events) will see NIFTY drift away from VWAP for hours — dev_momentum will show false positive turns repeatedly
VWAP stddev normalizer needs 30 min of warmup; first 30 min of session the z-score threshold is unreliable
Dev momentum 24-bar window can signal too early if selling is in multiple legs — final flush can hit stop
